name: ScreenConnect
summary: ScreenConnect is a remote support and access tool for IT teams and service providers, licensed per concurrent technician. The Standard plan costs $47 a month billed annually, or $62 billed monthly, and includes unlimited unattended access and session recording. It can run in ConnectWise's cloud or on the buyer's own server. Self-hosted servers need prompt patching, as the February 2024 authentication bypass showed.

facts.text: On February 19, 2024 ConnectWise disclosed CVE-2024-1709, an authentication bypass with a CVSS score of 10, in self-hosted ScreenConnect 23.9.7 and earlier, and CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on February 22, 2024.
ConnectWise said it remediated cloud instances itself, while self-hosted customers had to upgrade to version 23.9.8 or later.
The Standard and Premium plans list unlimited unattended access and session recording, and video auditing is listed for Premium only.
ScreenConnect's features page says it supports SAML for single sign-on and lets administrators filter audit logs by session name.
CISA's January 2023 advisory names ScreenConnect and AnyDesk as tools that criminals ran as portable executables in refund scams. The advisory recommends allowlisting approved remote tools.

plans.name: One
plans.notes: Annual billing only. Listed with a single license restriction.

plans.name: Standard (annual)
plans.notes: Billed annually. Unlimited unattended access and session recording.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For complex IT environments, with privileged access management and multi-year contracts.

hiddenCosts: The monthly-billed Standard plan costs $15 a month more than the annual one, and the monthly-billed Premium plan $15 more.
The pricing page does not state the length of the free trial.
